purpose: Add five gospel-centered, Scripture-connected public-domain hymns with verified playable music through the guarded hymn pipeline.
guardrails: Import only when the source page marks both words and tune Public Domain.
Require a direct Scripture connection and a clear grace, redemption, faith, revival, or praise theme.
Retain the exact source page and MIDI checksums with every record.
Keep Scripture references as topical indexes; KJV Scripture remains primary.
